fields.title: Unstated modeling choices and material transfers
fields.finding: Exact reproduction needs SiC nu=0.16, core E/G scaled linearly with density in pricing, radial/planar nodal loading, a rounded 48.894 kg gas item, and an integral of the expanding hard-impact footprint. The artificial growth law, typical core crush and transferred shell/film properties remain unvalidated.
fields.proposed_fix: Pin these input conventions and their PROJECTION tags. Keep primary measured properties distinct from transferred allowables and from predictions of installed damage tolerance.
